name: Stor:Age
source:
You need to free up some space on your phone by deleting photos, of course going through your photos brings up some old memories. Then you get a fateful text message.
[From [url=https://allbetsareoff.itch.io/storage] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你需要通过删除照片来释放手机上的一些空间，当然，浏览照片会勾起一些旧的回忆。然后你会收到一条命运的短信。
[来自[url=https://allbetsareoff.itch.io/storage] itch.io[/url]]
